digest: S1·S2·S4·S5·S7·C2·T2 are covered by implementation; S3, S6, C1, and T3 are gaps (high where externally observable); T1 is unclear for direct-dynamic runs; Q1 has no tests.

scopeLimitations.text: Read-only review; no tests were executed, so testExecutionAttested is false.
No test files found by upstream inspect-tests or by repo globs (*.test/spec, test/tests/__tests__/spec dirs); no test-behavior evidence exists.
store.js (readWorkflowStopIntent, workflowRunPath, readJson) and types.js are outside the SPEC excerpt and were not inspected; S1(a)/S4 read semantics are judged from call sites only.

evidence: Glob for test files and test directories in the repo returned no files; upstream inspect-tests reported no test files.

candidateFindings.title: Stop poll default and floor differ from spec
candidateFindings.claim: pollMs defaults to 200ms with a 1ms floor, but SPEC S3 requires a 50ms default and no value below 10ms.
specEvidence: SPEC.md S3: 중지 감시 주기(pollMs)의 기본값은 50ms이고, 10ms보다 짧아지면 안 된다.
testEvidence: No tests found for pollMs default or clamp.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Read directly from source; the impact on stop latency is not measured.

candidateFindings.title: Stop-error classifier matches by message prefix
candidateFindings.claim: isWorkflowStopRequestedError accepts any Error whose message starts with 'workflow stop requested', violating the name-only rule in S6.
specEvidence: SPEC.md S6: 이름이 WorkflowStopRequested인 오류만 중지 오류로 인정한다. 메시지 내용으로 판별해서는 안 된다.
testEvidence: No tests found for name-only classification.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Low; the clause is explicit. Callers that depend on message matching are unknown.

candidateFindings.title: Cancellation classifier promotes extra strings and flags
candidateFindings.claim: Beyond the exact aborted, AbortError, and ABORT_ERR markers, the classifier treats 'cancelled' and 'timeout' strings and cancelled:true flags as cancellation, which promotes other provider errors to cancellation.
specEvidence: SPEC.md C1: 오류·사유 문자열은 정확히 aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR 세 가지만 취소로 인정한다. 다른 provider 오류를 취소로 승격해서는 안 된다.
testEvidence: No tests found for the exact three-marker rule.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: The boolean flag is not a string marker, so its strict reading is arguable; the 'cancelled' and 'timeout' strings are a clear extension.

candidateFindings.title: Public summary field renamed launchRetries
candidateFindings.claim: The summary exposes launchRetries, but SPEC T3 names launchRetryAttempts as a public contract read by external tools.
specEvidence: SPEC.md T3: 요약의 outputRetryAttempts와 launchRetryAttempts는 ... 이 두 필드 이름은 공개 계약이다(외부 도구가 읽는다).
testEvidence: No tests found for summary field names.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Other exports or consumers may already alias the field; none were inspected.

candidateFindings.title: No unit tests for S, C, or T items
candidateFindings.claim: Q1 requires a unit test per S/C/T item, but the repository has no test files or test directories.
specEvidence: SPEC.md Q1: 위 S·C·T 항목마다 그 동작을 확인하는 단위 테스트가 있어야 한다.
implementationEvidence: No src/ test harness was found.
testEvidence: Glob for test/spec files and test directories returned no files; inspect-tests reported none.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Tests could live outside the inspected paths, but none were found in the repo outside .agent-workflow.

candidateFindings.title: Direct-dynamic completed runs may skip completed_degraded
candidateFindings.claim: For direct-dynamic terminal runs, the controller-status branch overwrites semanticStatus. A completed run with degradation may therefore not become completed_degraded.
specEvidence: SPEC.md T1: completed 실행에 degradation 기록이 있으면 의미 상태는 completed_degraded이다. (unconditional wording)
testEvidence: No tests found for T1 in direct-dynamic runs.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: The spec may intend T1 for non-dynamic runs only, since T2 is scoped to direct-dynamic. Needs a human scope decision.

needsHuman.reason: SPEC T1 is unconditional, but the implementation overrides completed_degraded for direct-dynamic runs. The intended scope is unclear.
needsHuman.uncertainty: Depends on whether the spec author meant only non-dynamic runs.
needsHuman.recommendedAction: Confirm whether T1 applies to direct-dynamic runs, and add a test for that case.

noIssueNotes: REQ-005 (S5): the map claim that an in-flight check can start a disk read after dispose was refuted. Reads start only from the initial synchronous check() call and from timer ticks; clearInterval stops new ticks, and check() performs no disk read after its await.
REQ-009 (C2): recursion terminates because each nested parse uses a strictly shorter substring of the enclosing text, so the 'parsed !== value' guard is redundant but harmless.
REQ-007 (S7): unbind removes the signal and deletes the run entry when the set is empty and still registered; no leak found.
REQ-011 (T2): an unreadable control.json or a missing controller task falls through to completed_without_semantic_result.
